# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(arrow)
library(sf)
library(ozmaps)
```


Example for a species

```{r}
data_traits_climate_raw <- arrow::open_dataset("data-processed/data_gbif_cleaned.parquet")

data_traits_climate_euc <-
  data_traits_climate_raw |>
  filter(genus == "Eucalyptus") |>
  collect()

taxon <- "Daviesia latifolia"
taxon <- "Abrotanella nivigena"
data_spp <- data_traits_climate_raw |>
  filter(taxon_name == taxon) |>
  collect()

data_traits_climate_raw |>
  filter(
    decimal_longitude == 134.1,
    decimal_latitude == -25.7
  ) |>
  collect()



data_spp_med <- data_spp |>
  locate_medoid_2d()

data_spp_med

plot_spp(data_spp, data_spp_med, taxon, file = "outputs/medoid_example.png")

```

How different is the result if we kick out all the Perth, Adelaide, Canberra samples? -- same good

```{r}
med1 <- data_spp |>
  locate_medoid_2d()

med2 <- data_spp |>
  filter(decimal_longitude > 140) |>
  locate_medoid_2d()

bind_rows(med1, med2)
```

# Deploy for lot of species

running for all 766 Eucalyptus species takes about 74 seconds -> 0.1 seconds per species
For 30k species, would take about 50 minutes, or 5 mins with 10 cores

Single core version
```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(tictoc)
tic()
data_taxa <- data_traits_climate_raw |>
  filter(genus == "Eucalyptus") |>
  nest(data = -c("taxon_name", "genus") |>
  mutate(
    medoid = map(data, ~ locate_medoid_2d(.x))
  )
toc()
```

multicore with furrr (51seconds)
```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(furrr)
ncores <- parallel::detectCores() - 4
options(mc.cores = ncores)
plan(multisession, workers = ncores)
data_taxa <- data_traits_climate_raw |>
  filter(genus == "Eucalyptus") |>
  nest(data = -c("taxon_name", "genus")) |>
  mutate(
    medoid = future_map(data, locate_medoid_2d)
  )
```

Excute for all, saving results

```{r}
taxa <- arrow::open_dataset("data-processed/data_gbif_cleaned.parquet")|>
  select(original_name, taxon_name, genus) |>
  distinct() |>
  collect() |>
  filter(!is.na(taxon_name)) |>
  filter(!taxon_name|> str_detect("/"))

output_dir <- "~/Downloads/climate_centres/"
file.path(output_dir, "data") |> dir.create(showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
file.path(output_dir, "figures") |> dir.create(showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

source("R/locate_medoid_2d.R")
taxon <- "Daviesia latifolia"
taxon <- taxa$taxon_name[17278]
process_taxon_medoid(taxon, overwrite = TRUE)

library(furrr)
ncores <- parallel::detectCores() - 2
options(mc.cores = ncores)
plan(multisession, workers = ncores)
taxa$taxon_name |>
#  future_walk(~ process_taxon_medoid(.x, overwrite = FALSE))
  walk(~ process_taxon_medoid(.x, overwrite = FALSE))

taxa$taxon_name[1774]
```

# Interactive map of points

```{r}

library(leaflet)

taxon <- "Daviesia latifolia"
data_spp <- arrow::open_dataset("data-processed/data_gbif_cleaned.parquet") |>
  filter(taxon_name == taxon) |>
  select(taxon_name, decimal_longitude, decimal_latitude, annual_precipitation, average_temperature) |>
  collect()

leaflet(data_spp) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers( lng = ~decimal_longitude, lat = ~decimal_latitude,
    radius = 4, stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.5, color = "red", popup = ~ paste0(
      "Precip: ", annual_precipitation,
      "<br>Temp: ", average_temperature
    )
  )
```
